mapper.insert: insert into ai_llm_call (session_id, agent_id, conversation_id, message_id, model_id, model_name, call_seq, depth, finish_reason, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, usage_source, duration_ms, response_id, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{modelId}, #{modelName}, #{callSeq}, #{depth}, #{finishReason}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{cacheHitTokens}, #{cacheMissTokens}, #{usageSource}, #{durationMs}, #{responseId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update ai_llm_call set message_id = null where session_id = #{sessionId}

delete.if:
delete from ai_llm_call where model_id in
#{modelId}

mapper.select: select count(1) from ai_llm_call where session_id = #{sessionId} and usage_source = '1'

select ifnull(sum(least(ifnull(cache_hit_tokens, 0), ifnull(prompt_tokens, 0))), 0) as hit, ifnull(sum(cache_miss_tokens), 0) as miss, count(1) as calls,
ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) = 0 then least(ifnull(cache_hit_tokens, 0), ifnull(prompt_tokens, 0)) else 0 end), 0) as mainHit, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) = 0 then ifnull(cache_miss_tokens, 0) else 0 end), 0) as mainMiss, sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as mainCalls, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) > 0 then least(ifnull(cache_hit_tokens, 0), ifnull(prompt_tokens, 0)) else 0 end), 0) as subHit, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) > 0 then ifnull(cache_miss_tokens, 0) else 0 end), 0) as subMiss, sum(case when ifnull(depth, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as subCalls from ai_llm_call where session_id = #{sessionId}

select ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, count(1) as callCount, count(distinct session_id) as sessionCount, sum(case when usage_source = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as realCallCount from ai_llm_call where create_time >= #{since}

select ifnull(c.model_name, concat('model#', c.model_id)) as modelName, c.model_id as modelId, ifnull(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(c.prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(c.completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, count(1) as callCount from ai_llm_call c where c.create_time >= #{since} group by c.model_id, c.model_name order by totalTokens desc limit #{limit}

select c.agent_id as agentId, ifnull(a.agent_name, concat('agent#', c.agent_id)) as agentName, ifnull(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(c.prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(c.completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, count(1) as callCount from ai_llm_call c left join ai_agent a on c.agent_id = a.agent_id and a.del_flag = '0' where c.create_time >= #{since} and c.agent_id is not null group by c.agent_id, a.agent_name order by totalTokens desc limit #{limit}

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, count(1) as callCount from ai_llm_call where create_time >= #{since} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day asc

select ifnull(sum(least(ifnull(cache_hit_tokens, 0), ifnull(prompt_tokens, 0))), 0) as hitTokens, ifnull(sum(cache_miss_tokens), 0) as missTokens, ifnull(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens from ai_llm_call where create_time >= #{since} and usage_source = '0'

select ifnull(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(c.prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(c.completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, count(1) as callCount, count(distinct c.session_id) as sessionCount, sum(case when c.usage_source = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as realCallCount from ai_llm_call c inner join ai_chat_session s on s.session_id = c.session_id where c.create_time >= #{since} and s.user_id = #{userId}

select date_format(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, ifnull(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(c.prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(c.completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, count(1) as callCount from ai_llm_call c inner join ai_chat_session s on s.session_id = c.session_id where c.create_time >= #{since} and s.user_id = #{userId} group by date_format(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day asc

select ifnull(sum(least(ifnull(c.cache_hit_tokens, 0), ifnull(c.prompt_tokens, 0))), 0) as hitTokens, ifnull(sum(c.cache_miss_tokens), 0) as missTokens, ifnull(sum(c.prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens from ai_llm_call c inner join ai_chat_session s on s.session_id = c.session_id where c.create_time >= #{since} and s.user_id = #{userId} and c.usage_source = '0'
